lea.text: The Hurloon Minotaurs came to Northern Aerona from Stahaan after being driven out by glaciers, and they are minotaurs who love battle and sing hymns for the dead.
The Hurloon and Talruum were devastated in the Phyrexian Invasion.

leb.text: In Limited Edition Beta, the Hurloon Minotaurs are shown as minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains who love battle and sing hymns for the dead.

sum.text: In Summer Magic, the Hurloon Minotaurs again appear as minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains who love battle and sing hymns for the dead.
